A letter for Rijeet…

♥
Boyfriend's
Day 2026

My dearest Baby Rijeet,

Happy Boyfriend's Day, my love. I have been sitting here trying to fit you into a few lines, and honestly, I can't. You are too much for words, but I will try.

From the moment you walked into my life, everything became softer and braver at the same time. You make ordinary days feel like scenes from an old love story.

I love the way you care. The way you notice when I'm tired, the way you make me feel safe even when the world is loud. You are my calm in every storm, and my favourite kind of trouble.

I love your smile, the one that shows up when you think no one is looking. I love your quiet moments, your silly ones, and even the days you are stubborn. All of you feels like home to me.

Thank you for standing beside me, for believing in me, and for holding my hand when I doubted myself. Whatever I become, you will always be a part of it.

I promise to choose you on easy days and hard days, in this life and in every other one. You are mine, and I am yours, darling, in every lifetime.

Please take care of yourself, eat on time, and never forget how deeply you are loved.

Forever and always yours,
Ritika 💋

P.S. Keep this letter. Read it whenever the world feels heavy.

Us, Always

A little note from me
Hey babe, I love you so much. I have always wanted to be with you, and I wish we stay happy forever. I am ending this note with love and a lot of kisses. I just want to hug you and kiss you. I love you a lot. Bye! 💋

A little something in my voice…

Open When…

Open when you miss me💌
Close your eyes and take a deep breath. I am right there with you, in every heartbeat. Busy days or long distance, my heart still runs to you first. Call me, I will be waiting with a smile. 💋
Open when you are sad💌
It is okay to feel low. You do not have to be strong all the time, not with me. Lean on me, I have got you. This too shall pass, and I will hold your hand until it does. 🖤
Open when you need a smile💌
You are loved beyond measure. You are handsome, kind, and the best thing that ever happened to me. Now smile, that is an order. 😘
Open when you cannot sleep💌
Think of me, and know I am thinking of you. Sleep well, my love. I will see you in your dreams. 🌙

My Promises

  • ♥ I will listen to you with my whole heart, phone away.
  • ♥ When you are down, I will be your biggest cheerleader.
  • ♥ I will try to say sorry first after a fight (I really will!).

  • ♥ I will love you a little more with every single day.
